integration_issues.issue: Fields may not render immediately after opening accordion section due to async data loading. A small delay (1-2 seconds) is needed after clicking section header before fields become available.
integration_issues.workaround: Add loading state indicator or wait for fields to be ready before interaction
integration_issues.note: All sections CAN render correctly when given proper time. This is a timing/UX issue, not a functional bug.
